# namespace_tenant_members (Data Source)

Fetches all user members and their assigned roles within the current Namespace Cloud workspace tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    namespace = {
      source = "bsuv/namespace"
    }
  }
}

data "namespace_tenant_members" "current" {}

output "workspace_members" {
  value = [for m in data.namespace_tenant_members.current.members : m.email]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Constant identifier for the tenant members data source.
- `members` (Attributes List) List of tenant members sorted deterministically by user_id. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) User's email address.
- `first_name` (String) User's first name.
- `last_name` (String) User's last name.
- `role` (String) Assigned role (`TENANT_MEMBER_ROLE_OWNER`, `TENANT_MEMBER_ROLE_EDITOR`, `TENANT_MEMBER_ROLE_ADMIN`, `TENANT_MEMBER_ROLE_READER`, `TENANT_MEMBER_ROLE_ACCOUNTANT`, `TENANT_MEMBER_ROLE_UNSPECIFIED`).
- `user_id` (String) Opaque unique identifier for the user.
